bundle.shortDescription: Install, update and open the PrismOpenResearch apps.
bundle.longDescription: Prism Hub lists every app in the PrismOpenResearch suite and installs, updates and opens each one from its signed GitHub release. It needs no account and never installs a file that fails its checksum and signature check.
